SELECT k.id AS k_id , k.user_id , k.work_log_id , k.item_id , i.title AS item_title , k.title , k.ai_summary , k.created_at , t.tag_id , t.tag_name , t.tag_color FROM sprout_knowledge k LEFT JOIN sprout_item i ON k.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN sprout_knowledge_tag kt ON k.id = kt.knowledge_id AND kt.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN sprout_tag t ON kt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY
k.created_at ASC t.tag_name ASC NULLS LAST, k.created_at DESC k.created_at DESC
